grammar.summary: 本课学习时间频度副词与一般过去时。

points.title: 一般过去时规则变化
points.explanation: 规则动词加 -ed：telephone→telephoned；以 e 结尾加 d；辅音+y 变 ies：study→studied。Did you...? 疑问用 did + 原形。

examples.en: He telephoned me four times yesterday.
examples.cn: 他昨天给我打了四次电话。

points.title: 电话场景表达
points.explanation: answer the telephone 接电话；接不到说 But I didn't answer the phone! 过去否定用 didn't + 原形。

examples.en: I answered the telephone at six o'clock.
